FRACTIONS.

125

The multipliers, that is, the quotients obtained by dividing 12 by 4, 3, and 12, are 3, 4, and 1.

Hence the sum of the fractions equals

| 9a − 12b | 8a − 4b + 4c | a − 4c |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  | + |
| 12 | 12 | 12 |
| 9a − 12b − 8a + 4b − 4c + a − 4c |  |  |
| = |  |  |
|  | 12 |  |
| 2a − 8b − 8c | a-4b-4c |  |
| = | = | . |
|  | 12 | 6 |

The preceding work may be arranged as follows:

The L. C. D. = 12.

The multipliers are 3, 4, and 1, respectively.

3(3a − 4b ) = 9a − 12b = 1st numerator. −4(2a − b + c) = −8a + 4b − 4c = 2d numerator. 1(a − 4c) = a − 4c = 3d numerator. 2a − 8b − 8c or 2(a − 4b − 4c) = the sum of the numerators. 2(a − 4b − 4c) a − 4b − 4c ∴ sum of fractions = = . 12 6
